# Pinned A2UI 1.0 source

These files are byte-identical copies from
[a2ui-project/a2ui](https://github.com/a2ui-project/a2ui/tree/5f6d26c48a5c61bf845cf1ef2a02a47e31e8d9ba),
commit `5f6d26c48a5c61bf845cf1ef2a02a47e31e8d9ba`.
The upstream Apache-2.0 license is preserved in `LICENSE`.
`UPSTREAM.json` records the SHA-256 digest of every copied file.

The envelope schemas, basic catalog and upstream cases describe upstream
validity. Ramflux profile acceptance is stricter and must have separate
expectations; these upstream files must remain unmodified.
